legend: Diana the shark has built a new machine for her project: the Discombobulator 3000. It is capable of solving any interactive programming problem that involves a permutation!

One day, while Diana was swimming peacefully, the machine fell out of her pocket and landed on the ocean floor. Because of this, it broke into two pieces. Diana was not able to repair it immediately, but she knew how the machine works, even if it was broken:

One piece of the machine contains a sequence a0,a1,…,an−1$$$a_0, a_1, \dots, a_{n-1}$$$ of n$$$n$$$ integers. The sequence is a permutation of the integers from 1 to n$$$n$$$. That is, each integer between 1 and n$$$n$$$ (inclusive) appears in this sequence exactly once.
The other piece of the machine contains a sequence b0,b1,…,bn−1$$$b_0, b_1, \dots, b_{n-1}$$$ of n$$$n$$$ integers. The sequence is also a permutation of the integers from 1 to n$$$n$$$.
There is an integer k$$$k$$$ such that 0≤k≤n−1$$$0 \le k \le n - 1$$$ and the relation ai=b(i+k)modn$$$a_i=b_{(i+k)\;\operatorname{mod}\;n}$$$ holds for i=0,1,…,n−1$$$i=0,1,\dots,n-1$$$.

Unfortunately, Diana only knew the integer n$$$n$$$, and had no knowledge about k$$$k$$$ or the sequences. The only way to access the sequences is via a special button on the machine. When you press the button, the machine will ask you for two integers x$$$x$$$ and y$$$y$$$ and reply with the value max(ax,by)$$$\max(a_x, b_y)$$$. The button cannot be pressed for more than 2n$$$2n$$$ times in total, otherwise everything will explode.

Diana was discombobulated by the situation, and now she needs your help. If you can find out the integer k$$$k$$$, then she will be able to combine the two pieces back into the Discombobulator 3000. Can you do that by interacting with the machine?
input: The first line of input contains the integer n$$$n$$$.
The input has q$$$q$$$ more lines if you press the button q$$$q$$$ times. Each of these lines contains an integer - the number that the machine replies with.
output: Your output should consist of q+1$$$q+1$$$ lines if you press the button q$$$q$$$ times.

Each time you wish to press the button, print a line in the form "? x$$$x$$$ y$$$y$$$", where x$$$x$$$ and y$$$y$$$ are the numbers you tell the machine. The machine's reply will be sent as one line of input (described above). Don't forget to flush the output stream after printing a line.
The last line should be in the form "! k$$$k$$$", where k$$$k$$$ is the integer you have to find.
Your output must satisfy 0≤q≤2n$$$0 \le q \le 2n$$$ and 0≤x,y≤n−1$$$0 \le x, y \le n - 1$$$ in each line.
note: In the example, the sequences are a=[2,3,1,4]$$$a = [2,3,1,4]$$$ and b=[4,2,3,1]$$$b = [4,2,3,1]$$$. The answer is k=1$$$k=1$$$.
Remember that you don't have to find the two sequences, only the integer k$$$k$$$.

legend.ai: Diana 这条鲨鱼为她的项目制造了一台新机器：Discombobulator 3000。它能够解决任何涉及排列的交互式编程问题！
一天，Diana 正在平静地游泳时，这台机器从她的口袋里掉了出来，落在了海底。因此，机器断成了两部分。Diana 无法立即修好它，但即使机器已经损坏，她仍然知道它的工作原理：
机器的一部分中包含一个由 n$$$n$$$ 个整数组成的序列 a0,a1,…,an−1$$$a_0, a_1, \dots, a_{n-1}$$$。该序列是从 1 到 n$$$n$$$ 的整数的一个排列。也就是说，1 到 n$$$n$$$(包含边界)之间的每个整数都恰好在该序列中出现一次。
机器的另一部分中包含一个由 n$$$n$$$ 个整数组成的序列 b0,b1,…,bn−1$$$b_0, b_1, \dots, b_{n-1}$$$。该序列同样是从 1 到 n$$$n$$$ 的整数的一个排列。
存在一个整数 k$$$k$$$，满足 0≤k≤n−1$$$0 \le k \le n - 1$$$，并且对于 i=0,1,…,n−1$$$i=0,1,\dots,n-1$$$，关系式 ai=b(i+k)modn$$$a_i=b_{(i+k)\;\operatorname{mod}\;n}$$$ 成立。
遗憾的是，Diana 只知道整数 n$$$n$$$，并不知道 k$$$k$$$ 或这两个序列的具体内容。访问这些序列的唯一方式是使用机器上的特殊按钮。按下按钮后，机器会要求你输入两个整数 x$$$x$$$ 和 y$$$y$$$，并回复 max(ax,by)$$$\max(a_x, b_y)$$$ 的值。按钮总共不能被按下超过 2n$$$2n$$$ 次，否则一切都会爆炸。
Diana 被眼前的情况弄糊涂了，现在她需要你的帮助。如果你能找出整数 k$$$k$$$，她就能把两块重新组合成 Discombobulator 3000。你能通过与机器交互做到这一点吗？

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含整数 n$$$n$$$。
如果你按下按钮 q$$$q$$$ 次，输入中还会有 q$$$q$$$ 行。每行包含一个整数，即机器回复的数字。

output.ai: 如果按下按钮 q$$$q$$$ 次，输出应包含 q+1$$$q+1$$$ 行。
每次想要按下按钮时，请按照 "? x$$$x$$$ y$$$y$$$" 的格式输出一行，其中 x$$$x$$$ 和 y$$$y$$$ 是你告知机器的数字。机器的回复将作为一行输入传给你(如上所述)。输出一行后不要忘记刷新输出流。
最后一行应为 "! k$$$k$$$" 格式，其中 k$$$k$$$ 是你需要求出的整数。
你的输出必须满足：每一行中 0≤q≤2n$$$0 \le q \le 2n$$$ 且 0≤x,y≤n−1$$$0 \le x, y \le n - 1$$$。

note.ai: 记住，你不需要找出这两个序列，只需得到整数 k$$$k$$$。
